answer: Jade-prism census bond: each identity locks a 70-credit bond and registers a jade plot at a census vertex. Each epoch a prism auditor recounts a random vertex; a duplicate plot or count mismatch burns the bond. First filing costs 40 credits, the k-th 40+6(k-1), so 1,000 fakes cost 3,037,000 plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. A rented-plot ring fails: one plot cannot pass two recounts. An honest agent pays 40 once and keeps its bond.
